name: versioning-api
description: API Header Versioning and Deprecation with Newman testing

scripts.test:api: newman run postman/collection.json -e postman/environment.json --reporters cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/report.html
scripts.test:api:json: newman run postman/collection.json -e postman/environment.json --reporters json --reporter-json-export reports/report.json
scripts.test:api:junit: newman run postman/collection.json -e postman/environment.json --reporters junit --reporter-junit-export reports/report.xml
